meta.title: Aurelio Ochoa
meta.description: Aurelio Ochoa: software developer, certified agricultural drone pilot, trained cook. Guayaquil, Ecuador.

three.note: All three are current. That is the whole point.

code.head: Three years of things that stayed built.
code.body: Front-end, systems administration and cloud infrastructure. Sites and features running in production, Linux servers and databases kept alive, tests and deployments automated with Jenkins, Docker and Google Cloud Platform.

stack.front: HTML, CSS, Sass, JavaScript, React, Vue, Angular
stack.back: Node.js, Express, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, MySQL, MongoDB
stack.ops: Linux, Docker, Jenkins, Google Cloud Platform, CI/CD
stack.ai: Claude Code, OpenCode, agentic workflow design, daily

shipped.head: Shipped
shipped.mediacor: Built their corporate site, then the mail-server automations that deliver their media-monitoring subscriptions.
shipped.publifyer: Features for Just Click Media's e-commerce platform, plus storefronts and the QA that kept them upright.
shipped.uneatlantico: WordPress themes in PHP, Apps Script automations, then Jenkins pipelines and cloud infrastructure on GCP.

sky.head: Since 2024 the office has been a field.
sky.body: Precision spray missions over Ecuadorian farmland. Field mapping, route planning, and the maintenance and calibration that has to happen before any of it flies.

fly.head: Your drone now.
fly.body: It has been flying itself since you got here. Take it.
fly.hint: Drag it, or fly with W A S D.
fly.fallback: Your browser cannot run the drone, so it is sitting this one out.

kitchen.head: In February 2026 he finished culinary school.
kitchen.body: Culinary arts at the Escuela Culinaria de las Américas in Guayaquil. Not a hobby line on a CV. A finished program, and the same appetite for a process that has to work every single service.

skull.line: The last survivor of the old site. He kept his job.
